project.name.label: Project name
project.name.description: The name of the formalized result or project.

project.description.label: Project description
project.description.description: A concise public account of the mathematical content and principal results of the formalization as a whole.

project.authors.label: Project authors
project.authors.description: People who authored the formalization. Enter one person per line; Palomar does not infer authorship.

project.license.label: Project license
project.license.description: The SPDX identifier for the repository license; it must agree with the repository license file.

project.responsible_maintainers.label: Responsible maintainers
project.responsible_maintainers.description: People responsible for the submitted formalization. Enter one person per line; Palomar does not infer this from authorship.

classification.arxiv.label: arXiv classifications
classification.arxiv.description: One or two arXiv category codes describing the mathematical content.

classification.msc2020.label: MSC 2020 classifications
classification.msc2020.description: Between one and eight MSC 2020 classification codes.

sources.label: Mathematical sources
sources.description: A nonempty list of sources for the result. Every source needs a title and an accurate relationship.

automation.methods.label: Automation methods
automation.methods.description: A nonempty list describing how the formalization was produced; use manual when no automated system was used.

review.status.label: Review status
review.status.description: The review completed before submission; this is metadata, not a Palomar endorsement.

repository.substantive_formalization.label: Substantive formalization
repository.substantive_formalization.description: Only for a thin wrapper: the owner/repository and full commit containing the substantive formalization.
